notes: Relative biome weights scale the regional candidate chance; they are not direct spawn percentages.
Any prohibited family vetoes overlapping positive families. Unknown biomes are closed by default.
Surface elevation and local relief veto Tectonic highlands even when their biome name is plains or forest.
TFMG owns native deposit columns, crude oil, reservoir amounts, scanners and extraction. Processing and depletion are unchanged.
Native TFMG placeDeposit is called once for each deterministic, eligible, chunk-owned well, not its unsafe random-walking whole-field place method.
Offshore fields currently share onshore size rules; larger offshore reserves/pressure/extraction balancing remains a future phase.
Y=-64 is the installed TFMG scanner contract. Do not change reservoir_y without a matching scanner change.
